plainTranslation: Their Pluto in your 12th house can pull hidden material into the relationship: old fears, compulsions, secrets, or unconscious power patterns. It may feel impossible to stay neutral. Bring the shadow into language before it starts making choices for you.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
